outcome: Neonatal outcomes (5-min Apgar score, neonatal weight, meconium stained fluid rate, admission to the neonatal intensive care unit rate)
finding: Advanced maternal age (AMA) was significantly associated with increased risk of spontaneous abortion, preterm delivery, and congenital malformations, but did not significantly affect other obstetric or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women of advanced maternal age had a greater number of cesarean sections compared to the control group, who had a greater number of vaginal deliveries.
